optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Merge

## Rules

- Export synchronous pure `mergeSchemaLayers(base: SchemaYamlData, layers: readonly SchemaLayer[]): SchemaYamlData` in `domain/services/merge-schema-layers.ts`. No I/O, no side effects.
- `SchemaLayer`: `source` `"extends"|"plugin"|"override"`, human `ref`, optional `operations` `remove|create|prepend|append|set`.
- Per-layer order: remove → create → prepend → append → set. Caller layer order: root-to-parent `extends`, `schemaPlugins` declaration order, at most one `schemaOverrides`.
- Identity: `artifacts[]` `id`; `workflow[]` `step`; hooks pre/post, validations, deltaValidations, rules pre/post, preHashCleanup `id`; metadataExtraction `rules|constraints|scenarios|context` `id`. Nested op locates parent by identity, then child array.
- `remove`: delete existing identity; `null` clears optional scalar; missing entry or required scalar throws `SchemaValidationError`. `create|prepend|append`: reject identity collision; preserve declaration order. `set`: scalars last-writer-wins; array entry must exist and is replaced in place.
- Targets mirror schema: scalars `name|version|description|compat`; `artifacts`; `workflow`; nested arrays. Post-merge: unique identities; no dangling `artifact.requires`. Errors name offending layer and operation. Return new `SchemaYamlData`; never mutate `base` or layers.

## Constraints

- Pure domain service in `domain/services/`. No fs, yaml, zod, I/O. No imports from application/, infrastructure/, composition/.
- Synchronous. Operates intermediate `SchemaYamlData` below entities / `buildSchema`.
- All failures throw `SchemaValidationError` with layer and operation context.
